steps.markdown: A **dense** (fully connected) layer connects every input to every output neuron. Each output has one weight per input plus a bias.
Parameter count = inputs × outputs + outputs. A layer from 784 inputs (a 28×28 image) to 128 neurons has 784 × 128 + 128 = **100,480** parameters.
A network is a stack: the **input layer** (your features), one or more **hidden layers**, and an **output layer** sized for the task, like 10 neurons for 10 digit classes.
**Width** is neurons per layer; **depth** is the number of layers. Deeper networks can build features in stages (edges → shapes → objects), which is why "deep" learning took off.
